title: Mission: The Money Checker
subtitle: Build the banknote checker and see how it verifies money.
summary: Meet the money checker, learn its parts, and test if a note is real.
activityInstruction: Feed a note in and watch the checker inspect it.

storyQuestions.prompt: What does a money checker do?
storyQuestions.success: A money checker checks if a note is real.

storyQuestions.prompt: Where does the note go in?
storyQuestions.success: The note goes into the slot.

storyQuestions.prompt: What part rolls the note through?
storyQuestions.success: The rollers pull the note through.

storyQuestions.prompt: What checks the note for marks?
storyQuestions.success: A sensor and light check the note.

quiz.prompt: Which part pulls the note inside?
quiz.success: The rollers grip and pull the note.
The display shows if the note is real.

quiz.prompt: What do you put in the checker?
quiz.success: You put a banknote in the checker.

parts.label: Note Slot
parts.fact: The slot is where you feed the banknote into the machine.
parts.help: The opening at the front of the machine.

parts.label: Roller
parts.fact: The rollers grip the note and pull it through the machine.

parts.label: Sensor
parts.fact: The sensor checks the note for the marks that make it real.
parts.help: The small box under the slot.

parts.label: Display
parts.fact: The display shows whether the note is real or fake.
parts.help: The screen on the front of the machine.

parts.label: Casing
parts.fact: The casing holds all the parts together and keeps them safe.
parts.help: The outer shell of the machine.
